lines.text: The LORD of Hosts says those who add house to house will see great mansions left unoccupied.
Those who pursue strong drink go into exile, and Sheol swallows Egypt's nobles and masses.
Mankind will be brought low, and the LORD of Hosts will be exalted by His justice.
Woes fall on those who call evil good and acquit the priests for a bribe.
The LORD's anger burns against His people, and He lifts a banner for the distant nations.
